name: {{SERVICE}} — Golden Signals ({{ENV}})
description: Golden-signals dashboard for {{SERVICE}} on {{STACK}}. Widgets: uptime, latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate, throughput, JVM/runtime, log-error rate, top errors, deployment markers. Generated by BMAD DCA Operations agent.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result='SUCCESS') AS 'Uptime %' FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE monitorName='{{SYNTHETIC_MONITOR_NAME}}' SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 95, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName='{{SERVICE}}' AND environment='{{ENV}}' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error rate %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName='{{SERVICE}}' AND environment='{{ENV}}' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName='{{SERVICE}}' AND environment='{{ENV}}' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT average({{METRIC_SATURATION}}) FROM Metric WHERE service.name='{{SERVICE}}' AND environment='{{ENV}}' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name='{{SERVICE}}' AND environment='{{ENV}}' AND level='ERROR' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName='{{SERVICE}}' AND environment='{{ENV}}' FACET error.class SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 10
SELECT timestamp, revision, user FROM Deployment WHERE entityGuid='{{ENTITY_GUID}}' SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20
